name: Fluid Lending
rootCause: Fluid DeFi protocol’s off-chain Merkle rewards distribution infrastructure was compromised. The attacker used compromised proposer and approver operational keys to submit fake Merkle roots and claim rewards with empty proofs, resulting in approximately $215K loss. Core lending, DEX, and user funds were unaffected. The team revoked the compromised keys and paused claims for upgrades.

descriptions.text: Fluid DeFi protocol’s off-chain Merkle rewards distribution infrastructure was compromised. The attacker used compromised proposer and approver operational keys to submit fake Merkle roots and claim rewards with empty proofs, resulting in approximately $215K loss. Core lending, DEX, and user funds were unaffected. The team revoked the compromised keys and paused claims for upgrades.

On 31 May 2026, Fluid Lending's off-chain Merkle reward distribution system on Ethereum was compromised when an attacker gained control of both proposer and approver keys. This enabled unauthorized claims of over $215,000 in FLUID, GHO, and cbBTC, which were rapidly swapped and laundered via Tornado Cash. The attacker obtained both proposer and approver keys for Fluid's Merkle reward system, bypassing intended 2-key authorization and enabling fraudulent reward claims.
